definitions.explanation: Withdrawal from one's profession, career, or public life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{引退|いんたい}する⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I plan to retire next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引退|いんたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表：03562_happyou⟧。
{引退|いんたい}⟦{試合|じあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。

notes:
{引退|いんたい} refers to retirement from a career or profession.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {引退|いんたい}する (to retire)
- {引退|いんたい}を{表明|ひょうめい}する (announce retirement)
- {引退|いんたい}{試合|じあい} (retirement match/game)
- {引退|いんたい}{後|ご} (after retirement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引退|いんたい}: retirement (from career/profession)
- {退職|たいしょく}: leaving a job, retirement from work
- {定年|ていねん}: mandatory retirement age
